title: huperzia elmeri
intro: Huperzia elmeri, commonly known as the Philippine liverwort, is a species of liverwort in the family Huperziaceae. It is a rare and endangered plant native to the Philippines, traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is reported to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, exhibiting therapeutic actions such as hepatoprotective and anti-cancer effects. The bioactive constituents of Huperzia elmeri include huperzine A, a potent inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase, which may contribute to its neuroprotective and cognitive-enhancing effects.
